name: 62864 · Mount Vernon, IL
findings: ZIP 62864 (Mount Vernon) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62864 (Mount Vernon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
